response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile software craftsman with deep experience across web, systems, and low-latency programming, but his career is overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D language, with only marginal, dated exposure to Java (robotic arms tooling, C IDE work) and no evidence of Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or IDE/language-tooling internals. This is a significant mismatch against the role's core requirement of deep JVM/Java/Kotlin/Spring expertise.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across large-scale, complex systems and infrastructures
Demonstrated experience building developer tooling, testing frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and open-source project leadership
concerns: No recent or substantial Java experience; Java appears only briefly in older roles (2016-2018)
No mention of Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate anywhere in the resume
No direct experience with IDE internals or language tooling development (the core focus area of this role)

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling experience
Strong general software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
